title: Rubric
description: How the judge decides. Hard no-go rules reject an idea outright; scores rank the rest.

tool_first.description: suggest = list the tools each idea needs and propose installing them later; strict = reject ideas whose core needs a tool you do not have.

max_poc_days.description: Ideas estimated to take longer than this are rejected.

no_go.description: Hard rejection rules. One match is enough. Turn off or edit the defaults, or add your own.

scores.description: Built-in 1–5 scores. Each score must be backed by a quote or link from the idea's source, otherwise it counts as 1.

weight.description: Multiplier in the total. 0 turns the score off.

top_n.description: How many ideas get a full report per run.

min_sum.description: Ideas whose weighted total is below this are rejected even if there is room.
